create_turklikeagent: create a TurkLikeAgent instance wrapping a bot model agent to simulate a Turker in Parlai crowdsourcing tasks
act_turklikeagent: call act on a TurkLikeAgent to get the bot model's response with normalized text and turn tracking
observe_turklikeagent: call observe on a TurkLikeAgent to feed an observation into the wrapped bot model with semaphore protection
reset_turklikeagent: call reset on a TurkLikeAgent to reset the underlying bot model agent's conversation state
get_bot_agents: call get_bot_agents to load and share multiple Parlai model agents from config strings for MTurk tasks
